required_safety_text: This does not approve Redis trim.
This does not approve exchange mutation.
This is paper-only shutdown decision capture.

current_evidence.observed_state: Operator decision families for paper-edge thresholds and unified-feature acceptance are explicit and unaccepted.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Production equivalence cannot mark resolved while the operator-controlled paper-edge thresholds and unified-feature acceptance remain unselected. Legacy shutdown stays blocked because edge proof and full observation depend on these accepted thresholds.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Accept the documented limitation for paper-only shutdown evaluation only. Live/canary remain blocked. No approval token is created by this capture packet.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require concrete operator thresholds and unified-feature acceptance to be wired with raw evidence before any paper-only shutdown decision is captured.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer this decision and keep legacy running. V2 stays paper-only. No shutdown is captured.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: Paper-only shutdown could proceed without strict operator-numeric thresholds; live/canary still blocked. Misinterpretation risk if operator later assumes thresholds were validated.
decisions.risk_if_deferred: Legacy keeps running. V2 production-equivalence stays incomplete. Slower migration but zero exchange-side risk.

current_evidence.observed_state: Checkpoint weight blob is operator-required; promotion path is not signed.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Without a signed checkpoint promotion, V2 inference parity with legacy cannot be claimed. Legacy shutdown is unsafe because trainer outputs needed for paper-only continuity are not promoted under operator authority.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Accept that the current checkpoint promotion gap is acceptable for paper-only legacy shutdown. Live/canary stay blocked.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require an operator-signed checkpoint promotion with raw weight blob lineage before any paper-only shutdown is captured.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer the decision. Keep legacy trainer/runtime running until checkpoint promotion is operator-signed.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: V2 may run paper without a fully-signed checkpoint; explainability/lineage gaps could appear in audit.
decisions.risk_if_deferred: Migration delay; ongoing cost of keeping legacy alive; no exchange-side risk.

current_evidence.observed_state: No operator-signed acceptance to stop legacy runtime owner. Legacy processes remain active.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Stopping the legacy runtime requires explicit operator authority. Without it, no shutdown action is permitted regardless of V2 readiness.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Operator accepts authority to stop legacy runtime for paper-only V2 continuity. This capture does not itself execute the stop; it captures the decision intent. Live/canary stay blocked.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require fully-documented stop runbook, rollback plan, and Codex review before capturing the legacy runtime stop decision.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer. Keep legacy runtime active. No stop intent captured.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: Operator commits to a stop intent that can later be executed by a separate operator-gated runbook. Misexecution outside the runbook could disrupt observability.
decisions.risk_if_deferred: Dual-system overhead continues; no exchange-side risk.

current_evidence.observed_state: Legacy Redis keys still hold live data lineage. No operator decision to trim or retain.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Without explicit operator decision on trim/retention, V2 cannot safely assume legacy Redis is decommissioned. Trimming without operator authority risks losing audit lineage; not trimming leaves attack surface and key collisions.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Operator captures intent to retain legacy Redis read-only and treat keys as frozen lineage for paper-only shutdown. Capture packet does NOT trim Redis. No write occurs.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require backup verification and trim runbook with Codex review and rollback plan before any retention decision is captured.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer. Legacy Redis keeps running with active keys. No trim, no retention intent captured.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: Frozen lineage requires periodic re-verification; misuse risk if a downstream job assumes the legacy keys are fresh.
decisions.risk_if_deferred: Storage growth and audit ambiguity continue; no exchange-side risk.

decisions.decision_label: risk/capital caps and canary hard gates

current_evidence.observed_state: Hard risk caps and canary gates are unset. No operator-signed numeric caps exist for live/canary.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Production-equivalence claim requires that the live/canary risk frame is fully described, even if live remains blocked. Without operator caps, paper-only shutdown cannot be evaluated against the documented live frame.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Operator accepts that risk caps remain unset because V2 is paper-only and live is blocked. Capture explicitly states caps are unset and live remains blocked_human_only.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require operator-signed numeric risk caps and canary hard gates before paper-only shutdown is captured, even though live remains blocked.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer. Legacy keeps running. Risk caps remain unset and V2 remains paper-only with live blocked.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: Caps remain unset; any future attempt to enable canary must trip a fresh operator gate. Risk surface only if a separate gate is bypassed.

decisions.decision_label: capital recovery threshold / risk guard acceptance

current_evidence.observed_state: Capital recovery threshold and risk guard are unset and operator-required.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Capital recovery threshold informs the paper-edge proof statistics and any future canary capital frame. Without it, paper-only shutdown evaluation lacks an operator-signed loss/recovery boundary.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Operator accepts that for paper-only shutdown the capital recovery gate is documented as unset; V2 remains paper-only and live remains blocked.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require operator-signed numeric capital recovery threshold and risk guard before paper-only shutdown is captured.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer. Legacy keeps running. Capital recovery gate remains unset.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: No numeric recovery target captured; paper-only metrics may lack a defensible boundary. Live remains blocked so no capital is at risk.
decisions.risk_if_deferred: Continued dual-system overhead; no exchange-side risk.

current_evidence.observed_state: All external-source families lack present env-var names. The capture packet checks names only and never reads raw secret values.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Full observation builder cannot satisfy external-source families without operator-approved adoption (free-tier confirmation OR paid-tier secret name presence). Until adopted, paper-only shutdown is gated.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Operator accepts that external sources remain unadopted for paper-only shutdown and that full observation will continue to operate with the documented gap. Live/canary remain blocked.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require operator to set V2_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_FREE_TIER_CONFIRMED + V2_EXTERNAL_SOURCE_CODEX_SAFE_CONFIRMED for free-tier OR provide the named secrets (by name only, the capture does not read values) before paper-only shutdown is captured.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer. Keep legacy running and leave full-observation external-source family blocked.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: Full observation operates with documented external-source gaps. Model edge proof may remain weaker; live remains blocked so no exchange risk.

current_evidence.observed_state: Watcher remains active and has not observed real per-symbol liquidation evidence. No fabricated completion is permitted.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Full observation requires real per-symbol liquidation events. Without them, the paper-only shutdown decision cannot rely on full observation; the watcher must stay open.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Operator accepts that liquidation-event observation remains pending for paper-only shutdown; V2 continues paper-only with the documented gap. Live/canary remain blocked.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require real per-symbol liquidation event observed and aggregator source available before paper-only shutdown is captured.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer. Keep legacy running until the watcher passes on real evidence.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: Full-observation continues with documented liquidation gap; live remains blocked so no exchange risk.

current_evidence.observed_state: After-cost edge is negative; CI lower bound is negative; minimum sample not satisfied; operator thresholds not set.

decisions.why_it_blocks_shutdown_live: Paper-edge is the foundation of any post-legacy decision. Negative after-cost edge with unset operator thresholds means paper-only shutdown cannot claim a defensible edge frame.

option_A_accept_for_paper_only_shutdown.description: Operator accepts that paper-edge remains unproven for the purpose of paper-only shutdown evaluation. V2 stays paper-only no-trade or fail-closed. Live/canary remain blocked.

option_B_require_implementation_before_s.description: Require operator numeric thresholds AND statistically defensible positive after-cost paper/shadow expectancy before paper-only shutdown is captured.

option_C_defer_keep_legacy_running.description: Defer. Keep legacy running until paper-edge passes with operator thresholds and positive after-cost evidence.

decisions.risk_if_accepted: V2 operates paper-only with an explicitly unproven edge; misinterpretation risk if anyone treats this as a green light. Live remains blocked.
